text_original: Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of a 530Li states the front and rear styling is elegant and eye-catching. Owner states there is noticeable wind and road noise, with a humming sound at higher speeds.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner states the drivetrain is a main reason for satisfaction with the 530Li. Owner states the ride comfort is good. Owner states the rear design is too conservative.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner states the 360-degree camera and parking aids are among the things they like most. Owner states the price has barely dropped while rival brands have cut prices sharply.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner (previously drove a Mazda Atenza) states noise insulation is good. Owner states they dislike the hidden (flush) door handles. Owner who test-drove the Audi A6L and the new Cadillac CT6 states the A6L felt comfort-oriented and less sporty, and the CT6 less agile than the BMW. Owner states current discounts plus brand strength and resale value made the 5 Series better value than the Audi A6L and Cadillac CT6.
Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner states the test drive showed strong power. Owner states the raised rear centre floor tunnel is awkward for elderly or child passengers.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner states the lighting is a highlight of the car. Owner states features were removed, citing a sunroof that cannot open and no electric adjustment of the rear passenger seat. Owner states the trunk is small even though the car carries no spare tyre. Owner states the left rear window motor was faulty at delivery. Owner states the gear selector is easy to misoperate, slipping from S into N. Owner states fuel consumption exceeds 10 L/100 km in congested city traffic.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner who compared the Mercedes E-Class and Audi A6L states the 5 Series still feels easier to drive than both rivals. Owner states the interior falls noticeably short of the Mercedes E-Class. Owner states the interior is clearly better than the Audi A6L's. Owner states initial acceleration from standstill is quicker than the Mercedes E-Class. Owner states the Mercedes E-Class pulls harder in the mid-range, and the BMW throttle response feels light. Owner states handling has lost some edge, with noticeable body roll in quick steering, which they attribute to a removed anti-roll bar. Owner dislikes the rear design and that the Hofmeister kink was dropped.
Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner states the new car has a noticeable interior odour. Owner states maintenance costs are high.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of a 525Li states fuel use is low (about 7.5 L/100 km). Owner states the car no longer comes with Pirelli run-flat tyres and sees some cost-cutting.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of a 525Li states the headlights are bright and distinctive. Owner states tyre noise becomes noticeable above about 120 km/h. Owner states the interior materials are good and the screen feels high-tech.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of a 525Li states handling, ride comfort and driving feel are what they like most. Owner states acceleration is good but the driving feel is not as good as the Mercedes E300. Owner states the exterior looks too youthful and prefers the more businesslike look of the previous 5 Series. Owner states the interior feels localized and less grand than earlier premium models. Owner states the dealer (4S store) service was poor and they felt disrespected.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of a 525Li states the ride is smooth and steering needs only small inputs. Owner states the audio quality is very good. Owner states the driver-assistance systems make the car easy to drive for less experienced drivers. Owner states real-world fuel consumption is higher than expected.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of a 525Li states a clicking, electrical-sounding noise comes from the brake pedal area when braking in D at low speed in traffic. Owner states the car lacks keyless entry and the sunroof cannot be opened. Owner states the suspension is too soft.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of a 525Li (previously a Cadillac XTS) states the 190 hp engine is sufficient. Owner states the rear is spacious enough to cross legs with the front seat set for the driver. Owner states there is an abnormal noise when turning the steering wheel at standstill. Owner states the nose dips noticeably under braking.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of a 525Li states rear legroom is generous and the trunk takes two 28-inch suitcases. Owner states the chassis feels solid and filters bumps well. Owner states the front seats are only heated, not ventilated, and the seat covering is synthetic leather. Owner states the audio system is a basic one and recommends the 530Li for buyers who want ventilated seats or premium audio. Owner states large dealer discounts put the 525Li below the price of a Mercedes E 260 L. Owner states they value the dual screens and wireless CarPlay.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of a 525Li states the gearbox shifts smoothly without jerks in stop-and-go traffic. Owner states voice control works well. Owner states the wireless charging pad is badly placed and charges slowly. Owner states the cupholders do not hold drinks securely. Owner states auto start-stop is annoying and has to be switched off manually every drive. Owner states the infotainment system is occasionally slow to start up and respond. Owner states city commuting uses about 12-13 L/100 km and a full tank gives under 600 km.
Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of a 525Li states the air conditioning does not cool, with vents measuring about 28 C at a 19.5 C setting, and took the car to the dealer.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner who considered the Audi A6L and Mercedes E-Class states the BMW interior is more fashionable than both, especially the crystal ambient lighting. Owner states the L2 driver assistance works well. Owner states the assisted lane change does not complete the move to the next lane. Owner states the audio system was de-contented and the sunroof cannot be opened. Owner states there is an abnormal noise when steering at standstill. Owner wants the voice assistant to be able to control the sunroof. Owner states they are not used to the gear selector.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner states the interior feels livelier than the Audi A6's and the ambient lighting is outstanding. Owner states the rear doors need a lot of force to close. Owner states the dealer service was good and they were satisfied after negotiating the price.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner states they got a 5 Series for 3 Series money, giving strong value in the class. Owner states the 2025 model year has fewer speakers than before. Owner wants the iDrive rotary controller to support handwriting input.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of a 525Li states the 2.0T with 8-speed automatic pulls away briskly and Sport Boost gives strong overtaking. Owner states a 1.78 m adult sits comfortably in the rear and the trunk is large. Owner states the car lacks keyless entry and a 360-degree camera. Owner wants the windows to close automatically when the car is locked.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of a 530Li states power is strong in Sport mode with a good exhaust note. Owner states the brakes squeal when pulling away and stopping. Owner states the tail lights are less appealing than the previous generation's. Owner states some surfaces feel like faux leather and the door trim looks busy with many seams. Owner states there is very little wind noise on the highway.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of a 530Li states the front crystal ambient lighting is what they like most. Owner states there is no ambient lighting in the rear, which feels plain. Owner states the new car has brake noise, which they attribute to break-in.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of a 530Li objects that remote climate start costs extra and the data plan is free for only three months. Owner states the stock Harman Kardon audio sounds muddy, so they added an aftermarket DSP amplifier. Owner states CarPlay can be customised on the large screen. Owner states a Mercedes E300 would have cost roughly 60,000 yuan more, which favoured the 5 Series. Owner states there is some jerkiness at low speed, although throttle and gearbox respond better than their previous car.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of a 530Li states spare parts are very expensive relative to the vehicle price. Owner states the car shakes slightly side to side when auto start-stop restarts the engine.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner who cross-shopped the Audi A6 45 quattro and Mercedes E300 states the interior is not as luxurious as a Mercedes but acceptable. Owner states adaptive cruise control works well on highways. Owner states the wireless phone charger is useless. Owner objects that remote climate control costs an extra 2,300 yuan. Owner states the long wheelbase makes the car spacious.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of a 530Li states fuel use is better than expected. Owner states the brakes make noise at low speed. Owner states the seats have no ventilation and no lumbar support. Owner wants to be able to disable auto start-stop permanently.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of a 530Li states the car has no ventilated seats. Owner states the audio has 12 speakers versus 16 on the 3 Series, with Bowers and Wilkins reserved for the top trim. Owner states the price, exterior, interior and dealer service were all satisfying.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner who upgraded from a 3 Series states other cars do not drive as well and the BMW makes driving enjoyable. Owner concedes the BMW interior does not match the luxury of the Mercedes E-Class. Owner rates the 5 Series as better value than the Mercedes E-Class. Owner states the rear feels smaller than in the previous generation despite the longer body.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of a 530Li states the car is noisy. Owner states fuel consumption is high at about 11.2 L/100 km. Owner states auto start-stop engages too frequently.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of a 530Li states the brakes judder outside Sport mode and squeal when parking. Owner objects that remote start costs extra and the data plan covers only three months, less than on the 3 Series. Owner states navigation guidance stops when other audio is playing. Owner states a 1.80 m passenger can cross legs in the rear.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of a 530Li states the interior, ambient lighting and floating curved screen are what they like most. Owner states the budget Hankook tyres do not fit the price and plans to replace them. Owner praises the automatic emergency braking.
Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of a 530Li states the seats are supportive and comfortable. Owner states wind and tyre noise are noticeable on highways.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of a 530Li states after-sales service is poor, especially at their Chongqing dealer. Owner states sound insulation is poor. Owner states city fuel economy is better than an Audi they compare it with (model not named), though highway economy is not as good.
Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of a 530Li states driving is precise and smooth. Owner states rear legroom, rear headroom and trunk size are tight and the car's weak point.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of a 530Li states the exterior is streamlined, sporty and elegant. Owner states the interior feels less luxurious than peers and lacks refinement.
